label: Industrial Location
description: Working and derelict industry — hangars, docks, mills and heavy infrastructure.

items.name: airplane-hangar
items.text: The interior of a massive, empty airplane hangar with a high, curved steel-truss ceiling and a polished, sealed concrete floor.

items.name: abandoned-runway
items.text: An abandoned airport runway with cracked asphalt, faded yellow markings, and a derelict, glassless control tower.

items.name: industrial-park
items.text: A tidy industrial park, sandwich-panel warehouses with rows of loading docks, rooftop HVAC units and fresh lane markings painted on dark asphalt.

items.name: shipping-dock-cranes
items.text: An industrial shipping dock, the scene dominated by the artificial lights of towering container cranes and immense, orderly stacks of cargo containers.

items.name: industrial-back-alley
items.text: A dim back alley between industrial buildings, steam curling from wall vents past dumpsters, conduit runs and painted steel fire doors.

items.name: cooling-towers
items.text: A decommissioned nuclear power plant, with the two massive, concrete cooling towers silhouetted against the night sky and lit by stark, orange-toned security lights at their base.

items.name: flickering-industrial-street
items.text: An aging industrial street, buzzing sodium lamps cycling on and off above rusted chain-link, graffiti layered across corrugated fences and bricked-up windows.

items.name: derelict-warehouse
items.text: A derelict warehouse interior, shattered skylights, ivy in the brickwork and dust sheeting through still air.

items.name: abandoned-factory-floor
items.text: An abandoned factory floor, rusted beams, broken glass and silent machinery under a high sawtooth roof.

items.name: steel-mill-pour
items.text: A steel mill casting floor mid-pour, molten metal arcing from the tilted ladle in a fountain of sparks beneath silhouetted gantry cranes.

items.name: turbine-hall
items.text: A power-station turbine hall, mint-green turbine casings in a long row beneath the gantry crane, waxed screed floor running to arched steel windows.

items.name: refinery-flare-stacks
items.text: An oil refinery under sodium-vapor light, flare stacks burning over a glinting lattice of pipework, distillation towers and drifting steam.

items.name: dry-dock
items.text: A graving dry dock with a ship towering above the floor on keel blocks, staging scaffolds climbing the rust-streaked hull plates.

items.name: open-pit-quarry
items.text: A working stone quarry, terraced benches stepping down to switchback haul roads, pale drill dust chalking every ledge.

items.name: aircraft-boneyard
items.text: A desert aircraft boneyard, rows of retired airliners with engines shrink-wrapped white and cockpit glass masked, tail fins fading in the dry glare toward distant mountains.

items.name: rail-freight-yard
items.text: A rail freight yard, strings of rust-red tank cars and graffiti-tagged boxcars on parallel sidings, oil-stained ballast and switch stands between the rails.
